notes: chainUses = reverse beat's limit: how many times one normal can come out in a single string of normals chained into each other (default, and per button: lights twice); remove it to switch the limit off. Combo rules (docs/specs/universal-systems.md section 4). Percentages out of 10000; first guesses, to be tuned. Decay tables: [comboTimeFrames, percent] - once combo time reaches a row, hitstun (or untechable time) is scaled by that percent; the last row is techOutAt, where it drops to nothing. techOutAt = after this many frames of combo the fighter being hit can tech out no matter what: any button in hitstun (ground: the groundTech state; air: airTech). A move's own numbers override the defaults. repeatDamage / repeatHitstun = a move used again in the same combo does this share of its damage and hitstun. LAUNCHES: a move's 'launch' is "hard" (the S launchers: high, super-jump cancel on hit), "soft" (a short pop, jump cancel on hit), or { type, x, y } with its own speeds (px per frame; no type = soft; the older 'launcher: true' = hard). hardLaunch / softLaunch = the speeds a move gets when it names none. hardLaunchLimit = hard launches per combo; one more acts as a soft launch. JUGGLE: every hit on an airborne fighter adds its 'juggleCost' (default juggleCost) to the combo's total, and a soft launch adds softLaunchCost (or the move's own); once the total passes juggleLimit the fighter falls out: the hit still does its damage but gives no untechable time, no launch and no bounce. bounceLimit = wall bounces and ground bounces per combo, each. HIT STATES are in hitStates (its own notes).

hitStates.notes: Hit states: what a hit does to the fighter it lands on, beyond plain hitstun. A move picks one with hitReaction: normal | slide | spin | tumble | crumple | softKD | hardKD (and counterReaction: the one it uses on a counter hit or Witness counter), and otg: true lets it hit a fighter lying in a hard knockdown. A move's own numbers (launch, airHit, untech) win over the ones here. Speeds in px per frame, times in frames, shares out of 10000. landing = the knockdown a fall ends in when the last hit names none (softKD or hardKD). SPIN and TUMBLE: air states. launch = the pop a grounded fighter gets (a soft launch) and the arc an airborne one is sent on; untech = untechable time; gravityPct = share of normal gravity while in it. SLIDE: the fighter skids away along the ground at speed, keeping frictionPct of it each frame, for frames (shortened by combo time), still airborne for combos, then a knockdown (endsIn). slam = the speed an airborne fighter is thrown down at first. juggleCost = what starting a skid on a grounded fighter adds to the juggle total. perCombo = slides per combo; one more is plain hitstun. CRUMPLE: perCombo = crumples per combo. softKD: techFrom = frames on the floor before a button gets the fighter up. hardKD has no numbers: the fighter lies for the knockdown state's length (common-states.json). OTG: damagePct = share of the move's damage; lift = the small pop back into air hitstun; untech = its untechable time; juggleCost = what it adds to the juggle total; perCombo = OTG hits per combo; afterThrow = may an OTG move pick up a thrown fighter (no combo is running then). Once a combo has used its OTG, every later knockdown in it is the soft one. Past the juggle limit every reaction becomes plain hitstun.
